T: Layered like an ogre. So is this menu.
D: An ogre sets out to rescue a princess so he can get his swamp back.
P: Serve the waffles when Donkey promises to make them in the morning.
S: Buttermilk soaked onion rings in a panko crust, barbecue mayo dip

Brown onions cut thick, separated, soaked in buttermilk for 30 minutes, dredged in flour, dipped in beaten egg and pressed into panko, fried at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Smoky barbecue mayo.
Gingy keeps his buttons, you get yours

Soft spiced gingerbread men piped with white icing smiles and finished with bright gumdrop buttons, one with a leg snapped off for the fans. Melt 125g butter, 100g brown sugar and 100g golden syrup. Stir into 350g plain flour, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon and 1 tsp bicarb soda with 1 egg. Chill 1 hour, roll 5mm thick and cut gingerbread men. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe faces with icing from 100g icing sugar and lemon juice, and stick on gumdrops as buttons.
Hot baked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chips

Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with chopped artichoke hearts, cream cheese, sour cream, parmesan and garlic, topped with mozzarella and baked at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Corn chips.
M: Beef chuck braised 3 hours with tomato paste and Worcestershire, peas, spinach

Beef chuck braised three hours in a rich tomato and stock gravy, with peas and spinach stirred through at the end so it turns swamp green. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 2 celery sticks for 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 750ml beef stock, return the beef, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Stir in 200g frozen peas and 100g spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.
Farquaad's perfect, tidy kingdom of Duloc

Chicken marylands rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted golden in perfectly neat rows with crispy potatoes and a sharp herb salsa verde. Rub 4 chicken marylands with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, lemon zest, oil and salt. Toss 1kg diced potatoes with oil. Lay the chicken and potatoes in neat rows on a tray and roast at 200C for 50 minutes until the chicken reaches 75C. Chop parsley, mint, capers and 1 garlic clove and mix with 80ml olive oil and lemon juice. Spoon over to serve.
W: Buttermilk waffles with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup
Buttermilk batter with melted butter and separated eggs, the whites whipped and folded in, cooked in a hot waffle iron until crisp, served with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup.
K: Green apple, cucumber, lime and mint blitzed with honey and ice
Green apple, cucumber, lime juice and a handful of mint blitzed with ice and a little honey until slushy.

s.note: Buttermilk soaked onion rings in a panko crust, barbecue mayo dip
s.how: Cut 3 brown onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Dredge in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until deep golden. Mix 100g mayo with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce to dip.

s.note: Hot baked spinach, artichoke and cream cheese dip with corn chips
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 1 jar chopped artichoke hearts, 250g cream cheese, 100g sour cream, 50g parmesan and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Top with 100g mozzarella and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling. Serve with corn chips.

m.note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours with tomato paste and Worcestershire, peas, spinach
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves and 2 celery sticks for 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 750ml beef stock, return the beef, cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours. Stir in 200g frozen peas and 100g spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Buttermilk waffles with whipped cream, strawberries and maple syrup
w.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 400ml buttermilk, 2 yolks and 80g melted butter. Whip 2 whites to soft peaks and fold through. Cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp. Serve with whipped cream, 250g strawberries and maple syrup.

d.note: Green apple, cucumber, lime and mint blitzed with honey and ice
d.how: Core and chop 3 green apples and 1 cucumber. Blitz with the juice of 3 limes, a big handful of mint, 2 tbsp honey and 2 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four glasses and serve straight away with a mint sprig.
